images.prompt: black-and-white editorial documentary photograph, Brazil, desaturated, high contrast, deep blacks, fine film grain, professional cinematic grade. VERTICAL PORTRAIT orientation, 2:3. COMPOSITION: the subject sits on the RIGHT half of the frame; the LEFT half falls into deep dark shadow, almost black and empty, so white text can sit over it. Low-key light from a window on the right. Everything in sharp focus, one single real photographic exposure. No text, no readable words, no numbers, no logos, no emojis, no added color. NO PEOPLE, no hands, no faces. SCENE: the owner's private office of a small Brazilian company, left in a hurry: a leather executive chair pushed back and turned away from the desk, the desk lamp still on, a phone off the hook, a single signed sheet of paper and a pen lying on the desk, the office door left half open to a dark corridor. The room feels abandoned at the worst moment.
